'''Kalit''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who became a [[Chief/Legends|chief]] and [[King/Legends|king]], leading a [[Kalit's clan|clan]] with his mate [[Aved Luun]], who served as the clan's [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]]. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Kalit had gotten into a rivalry with the [[Wittin's clan|clan]] led by Jawas [[Wittin/Legends|Wittin]] and [[Herat]], who organized raids and stole salvaged goods from other Jawas while accusing Kalit's clan of the acts. Going along with Wittin and Herat to the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of Tatooine's [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], Kalit was hoping for Jabba to mediate the clans' rivalry, not knowing that Wittin and Herat were in fact plotting with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to conquer Kalit's territories.

Kalit, Wittin, and Herat were present in the Hutt's palace when several allies of Jabba's [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] in an attempt to free Solo from [[Prison/Legends|captivity]]. Those events led to the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Jabba and Wittin, with the latter's death being to Kalit's good fortune.

==Biography==
===Jawa chieftain and rivalry with Wittin's clan===
[[File:Kalit_SWI_60.jpg|thumb|215px|Kalit was a Jawa chieftain on Tatooine.]]
The [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] Kalit<ref name="CCG" /> hailed from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of his [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE" /> He became a Jawa [[Chief/Legends|chief]]<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> and [[King/Legends|king]],<ref name="CSWE Iasa" /> leading a [[Kalit's clan|clan]]<ref name="FF" /> and owning a [[Kalit's sandcrawler|sandcrawler]] that provided enclosed shelter from the harsh Tatooine climate, [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], and [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]]. He also offered sanctuary to travelers, including members of enemy Jawa tribes.<ref name="CCG sandcrawler">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Kalit's Sandcrawler}}</ref>

Kalit's clan was also led by [[Aved Luun]], who was both his mate and a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]].<ref name="FF" /> The clan also included [[Thedit]], who organized perimeter patrols for Kalit's territory,<ref name="CCG Thedit">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Thedit}}</ref> and Kalit's friend [[Iasa]],<ref name="CSWE Iasa" /> whose influence with Kalit allowed the former's [[Jawa ionization blaster/Legends|Jawa ionization blaster]] to be equipped with improved ion regulators and a spare [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]].<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Iasa's Jawa Blaster|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/103Uiasasjawablaster.html}}</ref> At some point prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the prior events in {{Film|IV}} to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. {{CSWECite|II|74|Iasa}} mentions that [[Iasa]] was trusted with Kalit's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], mate, and [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]], with the credits spent, and between the mate and sandcrawler, one was sold and one was missing. That entry then mentions that Iasa was banished from Kalit's tribe before [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] went to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], which is part of the events of ''A New Hope''.</ref> Kalit went on a trip and trusted Iasa with his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], mate, and [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]]. Kalit returned to find his credits spent, and between the mate and sandcrawler, one was sold and one was missing. Iasa was subsequently banished from the tribe.<ref name="CSWE Iasa" />

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Siege of Jabba's Palace]] and the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. {{FactFile|23|JAW 1-4|Jawas}} established that the conflicts between Kalit and [[Wittin/Legends|Wittin's]] tribes began before those events.</ref> Kalit's clan had almost gotten into a war with a rival [[Wittin's clan|clan]] led by the Jawas [[Wittin/Legends|Wittin]] and [[Herat]]. Wittin stole salvaged goods and [[Water/Legends|water]] and organized raids on other Jawas, with the latter being staged by [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit]],<ref name="FF" /> another one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] Jawas.<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Wittin accused Kalit's clan of staging the raids, with both the raids and the accusations continuing even with the Jawa elders believing Kalit's innocence. For unknown reasons, Kalit approached Tatooine's [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to peacefully settle the long-standing issues with Wittin, hoping for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to mediate their talks,<ref name="FF" /> with Luun suspecting Wittin's betrayal.<ref name="CCG Luun">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Aved Luun}}</ref>

===Mediation attempts at Jabba's palace and Kalit's good fortune===
In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Kalit was in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine along with Herat<ref name="rotj" /> and Wittin.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Unbeknown to Kalit,<ref name="FF" /> Herat and Wittin were plotting with Jabba to usurp their rival<ref name="CCG Herat">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Herat}}</ref> and conquer Kalit's territories. Kalit was present<ref name="Who's Who" /> in the Hutt's courtroom after Jabba had chosen to convert the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] on behalf of their master, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], in an attempt to rescue Jabba's [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], into servants. When the Hutt dropped the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancer [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] into the pit of his [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|pet rancor]],<ref name="rotj" /> Kalit was among the individuals who rushed forward and watched Oola's [[Death/Legends|demise]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

[[File:Wittin.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Wittin, who planned to usurp Kalit, would ultimately not return from the Great Pit of Carkoon.]]
Alliance leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and Skywalker would later arrive to free Solo, with Skywalker also being dropped into Jabba's [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit. Kalit watched Skywalker fight back against the rancor, with the intended victim ultimately killing Jabba's pet. Jabba subsequently sentenced Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca to be executed at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]],<ref name="rotj" /> with Kalit's rivals Wittin and Herat accompanying the Hutt aboard the [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] for the trip.<ref name="FF" />

The trip would result in Jabba's captives [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fighting back]], with the Hutt being killed and ''Khetanna'' destroyed.<ref name="rotj" /> Fortunately for Kalit, Wittin died during the trip as well. During the next [[swap meet]] held at the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], Wittin's leaderless clan was absorbed into the other clans.<ref name="FF" />

==Personality and traits==
Kalit's trust in Iasa led to the latter Jawa betraying him.<ref name="CSWE Iasa" /> His generosity for travelers included even offering Jawas from enemy tribes a place in his sandcrawler.<ref name="CCG sandcrawler" /> Kalit entered Jabba's Palace in good faith, naively believing that a fair settlement was possible in the Hutt's court.<ref name="Who's Who" /> He jeered and peeked down into the rancor pit after both Oola and Skywalker were dropped in by Jabba. Kalit had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="rotj" />

==Equipment==
Kalit wore brown Jawa [[Robe/Legends|robes]] with a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]] strapped across his chest.<ref name="rotj" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalit first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. While not credited in the film itself,<ref name="rotj" /> [[Andy Herd]] acknowledged playing the character using a film still of Kalit peering down at the rancor pit during Skywalker's fight with the former.<ref name="herd">{{WebCite|url=https://www.top10films.co.uk/48706-star-wars-actor-andy-herd-dusts-off-the-photo-album-to-reveal-candid-shots-behind-the-scenes|text=Star Wars Actor Andy Herd Dusts Off The Photo Album To Reveal Candid Shots Behind The Scenes|work=[https://www.top10films.co.uk Top 10 Films]|archivedate=20211003060903}}</ref> In [[1998]], Kalit was first named by the ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. While that game itself only identified Kalit as a Jawa peering down at Skywalker's fight with the rancor,<ref name="CCG" /> the [[June 4]], [[2002]]<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20020510.html|text=Post-''Clones'' Fan Magazines}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]]," written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 60|sixtieth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, also identified Kalit as one of the Jawas who peered down into the rancor pit after Oola was dropped into it.<ref name="Who's Who" /> The scene where Kalit was peering down at Oola was filmed between [[January 25]] and [[February 2]], [[1982]], while the scene where the Jawa peered down at Skywalker was filmed between [[February 3]] and [[February 5]], 1982. Both scenes were filmed at [[Elstree Studios]]'s Stage 8.<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
